data.content:
I sent four disputes after you approved them. One case is weak and waiting on a document from you. The next deadline is 2026-11-24, 10 days away.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win chance | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-48290 | $27.40 | 90% | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Protein Bowl. The order was picked up 4 minutes after it was ready. |
| DD-48251 | $21.00 | 77% | The ticket lists the Chia Pudding. Pickup was 3 minutes after ready. This is a wrong-item claim, and there is no past history for that claim type. |
| DD-48267 | $16.50 | 82% | Pickup was 3 minutes after ready (12:52 to 12:55). The dispute says the ticket alone doesn't show what was packed. |
| DD-48230 | $18.75 | 70% | Pickup was 5 minutes after ready (13:24 to 13:29). The dispute says the ticket alone doesn't show what was packed. |

- **Lessons that applied:** DD-48267 and DD-48230 are missing-item claims with a ticket listing the item and a prompt handoff. They match this lesson: "doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1] won. Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won." That history is 2 wins and 1 loss. The loss was "the claim named a side item not itemised on the ticket", so check that the claimed items on these two orders are on the tickets. I didn't change any win probabilities because of it.
- **Lessons that didn't apply:** None applied to DD-48290, because the ticket omits the item there. None applied to DD-48251, because of the claim type.
- **Customer repeat claims:** DD-48267 and DD-48251 each came from an account with 3 claims this period. I left that count out of both disputes, so they say nothing about the customer.
- **What the evidence shows:** The tickets and pickup times show what was prepared and when it left. They don't prove what was in the bag.

**Weak, needs your input**
- **DD-48211 ($42.00):** It started at 60% and dropped to 35% because there is no order ticket on file. **Please send a photo of the ticket for this order.** I'll re-check the case once I have it. At $42, it's the largest deduction in this file.

**Not reviewed**
- **DD-48244 ($14.25) and DD-48280 ($9.50):** These are workable at 60%, but they were outside the top 5, so I haven't gathered evidence for them. I can run them next.

**Skip**
- **DD-48301 ($12.00):** The win chance is only 15%.
- **DD-47990 ($0.00):** The deadline passed 11 days ago and there is nothing to recover.

The case notes are in `/plan.md`. When any platform decision comes back, tell me and I'll record the outcome.
